In the run-up to the conference, Su Zheng, a non-party candidate who was famous for saving his fertility by legalizing the "one-wife, one-wife, one-wife" campaign to legalize his fertility, said that sleeping late last night and getting up early this morning led to "a little sleep deficit" and that he had little chance of winning the election under the current blue-green-crash electoral system, but he stressed that he was calm and that the election was intended to break the bipartisan framework and provide a third option for Taiwan's democracy and the New North. 17 minutes ago, the New North Mayor argued / pushed "1 wife, 2 wives, 1 wife" into the political debate. Su-hyun recognized that the election was a small 17 minutes ago.

heads.t: 感冒一有症狀就看醫生會好更快？醫揭真相 出現2症狀才急就醫 感冒才剛出現症狀，趕快去看醫生、吃藥，是不是就能好得比較快？耳鼻喉科醫師張弘指出，其實大部分的感冒都是病毒感染，而多數感冒病毒沒有特效藥，即使提早吃藥，也不一定能縮短病程。不過，如果出現發燒、全身痠痛等症狀，就建議及早就醫，因為可能是流感或新冠肺炎，這2種疾病有抗病毒藥物可以治療，及早診斷有助掌握用藥時機。 21 分鐘前｜健康 感冒一有症狀就看醫生會好更快？醫揭真相 出現2症狀才急就醫 21 分鐘前｜健康
